title: #361 Quick Learning
prompt: With the help of technology, students nowadays can learn more information and learn it more quickly. Do you agree or disagree with the statement?

promptSegments.text: With the help of technology, students nowadays can learn more information and learn it more quickly.
Do you agree or disagree with the statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology helps students learn more information.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology helps students learn more information.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology helps students learn things faster.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology helps students learn things faster.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology makes learning difficult because it provides too much information, which confuses the student and prevents deep focus.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology makes learning difficult because it provides too much information, which confuses the student and prevents deep focus.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology does not improve thinking skills because students rely on simple online answers instead of practicing critical thought.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology does not improve thinking skills because students rely on simple online answers instead of practicing critical thought.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology allows students to access a huge amount of information through online databases, making learning much broader than relying only on physical books.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology allows students to access a huge amount of information through online databases, making learning much broader than relying only on physical books.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, technology enables self-paced study through online courses, allowing students to rewatch difficult lectures and feel more confident.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, technology enables self-paced study through online courses, allowing students to rewatch difficult lectures and feel more confident.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology access alone is not enough for effective learning; good study habits and focus are necessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology access alone is not enough for effective learning; good study habits and focus are necessary.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The reliability of information found online is a major issue, making critical thinking skills more important than technology access.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The reliability of information found online is a major issue, making critical thinking skills more important than technology access.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
